title: 35C3 -  How Facebook tracks you on Android
summary: A 35C3 talk by Privacy International researchers who captured and decrypted traffic between Android apps and Facebook servers. They show many apps send Facebook device and usage data immediately on launch, even for users without Facebook accounts.
why: HN cites it as the source for how Facebook's SDK tracks Android users by default.

quote.text: after watching that 35C3 talk [1], I unzipped and grepped all those saved .apks
